turn.user_message: Why do our patients still get in so late?
turn.context: Prompt 1 of bm-pr-02. Transcript 9 (one team, both jobs at once), 11 (the filled chain) and 22 (allocate forward). bed-management.md §7.2 question 8: a claimed overlap tested against the clock, and the rule that beds are not given until ready.

transcript.label: After transcript turn 31 · Processes, turn 3 (the record stops at 31)

text: You already run discharges and admissions together. The wait comes from one rule: a bed is given only once it is ready.
bullets: Every step after that rule waits for it. So patients reach a bed between 4:30 and 8 PM.
Give the bed against the time it will be free. The papers and the call-in can then happen first.
The same team, beds and patients give a different day. It costs nothing but the new order.
chat.invite: Next, we can look at what a doctor is asked to do.
prompts: What does a doctor have to do?
What if a bed is not free in time?
Who needs to agree to this?

sheets.title: Bed given out
sheets.text: This one rule causes the late afternoon. A bed is only given once it is ready, so every step after it waits.
sheets.entry: Who decides a bed is ready today?

sheets.title: Patient called in
sheets.text: Today every patient is told the same time. With a free time for each bed, each patient gets their own.
sheets.entry: What time are patients told to come today?

sheets.title: Admission papers
sheets.text: Papers take about an hour of your 3½ hours. Done while the bed is still being cleaned, they stop adding to the wait.

lines.label: New
lines.value: Done while the bed is cleaned

sheets.entry: Which paper takes longest at your desk?

sheets.title: Bed cleaned
sheets.text: Housekeeping hears the leaving time from the plan. They are at the bed when it empties.
sheets.entry: How does housekeeping hear a bed is empty?

sheets.title: First bill on bed
sheets.text: The bed earns again only when the new bill opens. Bringing it to noon is the money in this whole change.
sheets.entry: When does the first charge go on today?

blocks.label: What it costs
blocks.sub: No hire and no system. The loss it removes comes from a rule, so changing the rule removes it.
